content:
Sometimes, a small change can make a big difference. For Apple users with a large amount of pre-loaded testing software, the latest TestFlight update perfectly illustrates this point.

Apple has just updated TestFlight for iPhone, iPad, Mac and other platforms. The new version 4.3 adds a "search bar" to help users quickly find applications.

Compared with version 4.2.2, it is clear that TestFlight now has a search bar added at the bottom of the iPhone and at the top of the Mac sidebar.

If you only have a small number of testing applications, you may find this change very basic, but for users with a large number of Beta applications, the search function is long-awaited.

This update also allows the "Previously Tested" category to display more applications. It is believed that general bug fixes and performance improvements may also be related to this.

Apple's TestFlight application can be downloaded from the App Store for iPhone, iPad, Mac, Apple Vision Pro and Apple TV.
